verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing docs say users can 'build automations' on the free plan, and developer docs describe event-triggered flows and flow performance reporting, so the core of event-driven lifecycle automation is evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows multi-step flow construction with conditional branches, time delays, or exit rules, nor welcome, onboarding or winback templates. missing for 10: documented conditional branching/splits, time delays, exit/filter rules, lifecycle templates (welcome/onboarding/winback), independent or hands-on corroboration.
